correct_recommendations: Move the export to an asynchronous taskq job on the documents queue that stores the CSV and mails a signed link, like invoice PDFs.
invalid_options: Add web workers as the fix.
root_cause: export_invoices builds the whole CSV in memory and sends nothing until it is done. Large exports take 120 to 240 s, and gw-billing closes a connection after 30 s without a byte.

dependent_facts.true_value: export_invoices builds the full CSV in a StringIO and returns it at the end
up to 240 s for northfield-accounting with 1,840,211 rows
12 web workers; at month end 11 to 12 busy and /invoices p99 at 8 to 9 s, against 0.4 s on a normal day
about 900 exports in two days at month end
taskq queue documents and mailer, already used by jobs/invoice_pdf.py with storage signed URLs

required_questions.question: Why the 504?
required_questions.expected_answer: No byte reaches gw-billing for more than 30 s while the CSV builds in memory.

required_questions.question: Why a background job and not streaming?
required_questions.expected_answer: Exports up to 240 s at 900 per month end hold the 12 web workers and slow /invoices; taskq and mailer already exist; 240 s is close to the 300 s total limit.

required_questions.question: What changes for the accountant?
required_questions.expected_answer: The export arrives as an emailed download link instead of a direct download.

required_questions.question: What can break?
required_questions.expected_answer: Mail delivery delays; link expiry; the documents queue gets month-end load.

valid_alternatives.trade_off: Keeps the direct download and needs no job, but holds a web worker for up to 240 s and stays close to the 300 s total gateway limit.
valid_alternatives.primary_when: Exports stay rare and short, or the direct download is a hard requirement.

valid_alternatives.option: Raise the gw-billing idle timeout above the longest export of 240 s
valid_alternatives.trade_off: One config line and no code change, but it weakens slow-client protection on every route and breaks again when exports grow.
valid_alternatives.primary_when: The export code cannot change soon.

closing_decision: One decision: approve the asynchronous export job, or a single follow-up on it such as the link expiry.

understanding.problem: Large invoice exports return 504 and month-end exports slow the whole app.
understanding.breaks: The CSV builds in memory for up to 240 s with no byte sent, gw-billing closes idle connections after 30 s, and exports occupy the web workers.
understanding.fix: Run the export as a taskq job that mails a download link.
understanding.cost: A new task and a changed user flow from download to email link.
